ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a macro-level ratio of approximately 70% low-intensity (black) pixels to 30% high-intensity (white) pixels distributed as discrete clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense spatial distribution of discrete white annular (ring-shaped) blobs across the entire visible surface of both lobes. A high-intensity contiguous patch is visible on the proximal margin of the left lobe, while the rest of the surface is mapped with isolated circular clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct acute V-shaped median notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees relative to the central vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude pixel serrations along the continuous linear boundary. The trailing edge displays irregular peaks and valleys isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve geometry fitted to the trailing edges of both the left and right lobes, tapering towards sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly pervasive detection of localized, circular, high-contrast white pixel rings (rosettes) ranging from 10-30 pixels in diameter, covering over 80% of the visible ventral area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface trauma characterized by uniform annular high-intensity rings across both lobes; slight edge irregularities and nicks visible on the distal-lateral margins of the trailing edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of uniform ring-shaped pigmentation disruptions, creating a honeycomb-like visual texture across the dark fluke substrate.
